claim: Legacy Mode is implemented in index.html
A full Legacy game was tested in headless Chromium including signing players, hitting the cap, releasing a player, confirming the XI, and running the sim
A Blind Spin Draft was run through to the sim
The Legacy game test run had no console errors
The Blind Spin Draft test run had no console errors
sim() is unchanged
createRun() is unchanged
build() is unchanged
Nothing has been committed
There is a new Game mode choice at the top of the UI offering Spin Draft and Legacy options
In Legacy mode the Ratings option is hidden
In Legacy mode the Rating pool option is hidden
In Legacy mode ratings are always visible
In Legacy mode every player is at their prime
In Legacy mode difficulty sets the budget at £450m for the easiest difficulty
In Legacy mode difficulty sets the budget at £350m for the medium difficulty
In Legacy mode difficulty sets the budget at £260m for the hardest difficulty
The How it works text changes to match the selected game mode
The player pool in Legacy mode contains all 2287 players in the dataset
Each player in the Legacy pool is shown once as they were in their prime season
Player rating, club, season and positions in Legacy mode come from the prime table that build() already makes
Player price formula is max(1, round(2 × 1.16^(rating − 70)))
A player rated 99 costs approximately £147m
A player rated 94 costs approximately £70m
A player rated 90 costs approximately £39m
A player rated 80 costs approximately £9m
The Legacy draft screen replaces the spin panel but uses the same formation, slots and pitch
The Legacy draft screen uses the same tap-to-place behaviour as Spin Draft
The Legacy draft screen uses the same tap-to-move behaviour as Spin Draft
The Legacy draft screen has a budget bar
The Legacy draft screen has a search box that matches names and clubs
The search box ignores accents so that kante finds Kanté
The Legacy draft screen has position filters built from the formation's slots
The Legacy draft screen has a Release button when a drafted player is tapped which refunds their fee
The budget guard prevents signing a player if the remaining budget would not cover the cheapest possible player for every other empty slot
Every position has a £1m option
When all 11 slots are filled the user presses Confirm XI to proceed
Legacy mode does not move on automatically when all 11 slots are filled
The teamsheet shows total wages in Legacy mode
The Redraft button is renamed to Edit XI in Legacy mode
Edit XI allows the user to return to the squad without losing it
Balance was measured using a greedy best-value XI in 4-3-3 run 300 times through the existing sim
With a £450m cap the greedy XI achieved an overall rating of 90.2
With a £450m cap the greedy XI achieved a Champions win rate of 48%
With a £450m cap the greedy XI achieved an Unbeaten 15-0 rate of 4.3%
With a £350m cap the greedy XI achieved an overall rating of 88.4
With a £350m cap the greedy XI achieved a Champions win rate of 34%
With a £350m cap the greedy XI achieved an Unbeaten 15-0 rate of 2.0%
With a £260m cap the greedy XI achieved an overall rating of 86.5
With a £260m cap the greedy XI achieved a Champions win rate of 15%
With a £260m cap the greedy XI achieved an Unbeaten 15-0 rate of 0%
A browser test signed Messi and Ronaldo early and resulted in a 78-overall team that went out in the league phase
The player list shows only the top 40 players a user can sign to keep rendering fast
Players a user cannot afford drop below the top 40 cut-off and are only visible via search
The row count is controlled by the constant LEGACY_LIST_MAX
The price curve is defined as a one-line constant named legacyCost
The budget caps are defined as one-line constants at DIFF[*].budget
The best-score record in localStorage is shared between Spin Draft and Legacy runs
